name: K5
note: K5 five-torus manifold: K4 (= QY-ED-share3, the complete graph K4 on 4 dims) plus a fifth dim (the neutrino circle) hosting all 3 nu mass eigenstates on a single NS-trio 2-torus Ma(d4, d5). Dims renamed to d1..d5 in size order: d1 smallest (b/t spoke), d5 largest (nu circle). 5 dims, 7 sheets, 12 mass constraints, 0 DOF (just-determined). See work/k5-manifold.md.
